education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

projects.title: Multi-Source RAG Assistant
projects.shortDescription: A smart document platform that lets you ask questions in plain English to search through complex PDFs, websites, and scanned files.
description: Enterprise-grade document intelligence platform enabling natural language queries across complex PDFs, websites, and scanned archives.
Delivering highly accurate, hallucination-free insights leveraging hybrid search architecture and Cohere neural reranking.
Robust data processing pipeline featuring stateful LangGraph workflows and scalable PostgreSQL memory.
Accelerating enterprise knowledge retrieval and streamlining data analysis workflows for unstructured data.

projects.title: Conversational Text2SQL Assistant
projects.shortDescription: An AI database assistant that lets anyone write complex SQL queries just by asking questions in plain English.
description: Intelligent database interface empowering non-technical stakeholders to translate natural language questions directly into complex SQL analytics.
Enterprise-ready security architecture featuring self-healing query execution and AST layers to block destructive database commands.
Optimized for extreme query speed and high throughput using Redis caching and advanced connection pooling techniques.
Comprehensive operational visibility and performance monitoring powered by live LangSmith telemetry.

projects.title: GitHub Autonomous PR Review Agent
projects.shortDescription: An automated AI code reviewer that instantly analyzes GitHub pull requests and leaves helpful feedback.
description: Asynchronous, event-driven PR review pipeline delivering instant automated GitHub analysis and code feedback.
Reducing code review turnaround time by 99% (from hours to seconds) using parallel LangGraph workflows and Redis queuing.
Ensuring feedback reliability and 95% accuracy using an LLM-as-a-Judge hallucination filter and Qdrant Vector DB memory.
Highly scalable backend infrastructure containerized with Docker and Nginx, monitored via Celery Flower telemetry.

projects.title: Multi-Threaded WebRTC Voice Agent
projects.shortDescription: A super fast AI voice assistant that you can talk to in real-time without any lag, just like a real phone call.
description: Ultra-low-latency AI voice companion platform featuring real-time, bidirectional WebRTC streaming for seamless conversational experiences.
Orchestrating LiveKit, Deepgram STT, and LLaMA 3.3 to achieve sub-800ms human-like voice response times.
Driving engaging user interactions through autonomous browser control and a dynamic 3D holographic Web Audio visualizer.
Scalable containerized architecture optimized for high-concurrency real-time audio processing workloads.
